heroBody: We build the verification and privacy tools so you can focus on finding the right person. Here's how we keep the platform — and you — safe.

verification.body: The verified badge is earned, not assumed: a member captures a live selfie in-app, and our safety team matches it to their profile pictures by hand. Verified profiles carry the badge and can be filtered for — always prefer them when connecting.

messaging.p1: Never share financial information in chats
messaging.p2: Don't send money to anyone you haven't met in person
messaging.p3: Be cautious of anyone rushing you off-platform
messaging.p4: Report suspicious behaviour with the Report button

meeting.p1: Meet first in a public place, with family or friends
meeting.p2: Tell a trusted person your plans before meeting
meeting.p3: Don't share your home address until you're comfortable

reporting.body: Use Report and Block on any profile. Our safety team reviews every report, and urgent ones — threats, underage members, scams — go to the front of the queue. Blocked members cannot view your profile or contact you.

emergencyBody: For platform safety concerns, email <mail>support@tricitymatch.com</mail>. Our team responds within 24 hours.
